answer.action: Write one next task on paper and work on it for five minutes.

claims.statement: A concrete next step reduces the effort of returning to work.

citations.excerpt: A defined next action lowers restart friction.

depths.core: Choose the task that matters now, then define the next visible step.
depths.deep: Restart friction often comes from having to decide what to do again. A written next step removes that decision.
depths.quick: Name the next step before you switch tasks.

answer.takeaway: A written next step makes returning easier.
answer.title: Return to one task
